Lazyfox

← back

Leader-key setup for Firefox. Press the leader key to open the which-key overlay (a paginated list of every Lazyfox binding plus native Firefox shortcuts); Tab / Shift+Tab to flip pages, arrows to select, or just press a binding's key. Changes apply immediately to open pages.

Sessions

tmux-style session manager: press ;p to save and switch named tab sets, ;' + 1-9 to jump to a marked session, ;| to split, ;{/;} to swap the panes, ;\ to close the split view.

Firefox chrome integration

Handled by chrome/userChrome.uc.js (installed by the Lazyfox installer - the standalone executable from GitHub Releases). These hotkeys open Firefox's built-in pages and work even on about: / error pages where the extension can't run. Changes apply live - no restart needed.

Keys work here too: Esc back · ; leader menu · j/k scroll
